key.name: window-width
key.description: Last normal window width in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last normal window height in logical pixels.

key.name: use-zsync-delta
key.description: Download only changed blocks when the update source provides zsync information. Disable this on very low-resource computers to avoid scanning the installed AppImage and calculating block checksums; updates will download the full file.

key.name: max-parallel-downloads
key.description: Number of updates downloaded at the same time. Set it to 1 on slow or metered connections; installing updates is always sequential.

key.name: max-parallel-checks
key.description: Number of applications checked for updates at the same time. Lower it when the update source limits concurrent requests or the connection is slow.

key.name: ui-scale
key.description: Percentage used to scale text and buttons.

key.name: github-token-cipher
key.description: Machine and user bound AES-256-GCM blob used when no Secret Service keyring is available. Managed from the GitHub section in Preferences.

key.name: github-token-status
key.description: One of none, unchecked, valid or invalid. Used to tell whether a token is configured even when the keyring cannot be read.

key.name: github-token-expires
key.description: Expiration value reported by the GitHub-Authentication-Token-Expiration header, when available.
